- **Playwright:** `npx playwright test --project=api api/generated/VEN-09.spec.ts` reports 1 skipped, because of the `test.fixme()` wrapper.
- **Type-check:** `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0.

The scenario's QA note says to wrap the test in `test.fixme()` until PLAT-412 lands. I followed it. If PLAT-412 has already landed, switch `test.fixme` back to `test` and the test will run. I did not run the assertion against the live API, so I have not confirmed that the 409 and `vendor_locked` response match the backend. The backend tests in `backend/tests/test_vendors.py` expect that code, so it's likely right.
